li.text: Settings marked * need a game restart. Settings for mods you don't have active are hidden.

li.label: Show armor and damage numbers
li.tooltip: Shows floating numbers for damage dealt and damage blocked by armor.

li.label: Deterioration alert ignores tainted apparel
li.tooltip: TD Enhancement Pack's "deteriorating things" alert stops counting apparel taken from corpses. The apparel still deteriorates as normal.

li.label: Haul downed mechs to shutdown zones
li.tooltip: Haulers carry downed colony mechs to a shutdown zone from WVC - Work Modes.

li.label: Haul unpowered mechs to shutdown zones
li.tooltip: When a colony mech has shut down for lack of power and no charger is free for it, haulers carry it to the shutdown zone cell nearest a charger it can use, out of the way until one frees up. Needs a shutdown zone from WVC - Work Modes.

li.label: Shutdown zones on other levels
li.tooltip: With MultiFloors, when a mech's level has no free shutdown zone cell, haulers carry downed and unpowered mechs up or down the stairs to a zone on another level, and mechs in a shutdown work mode walk there. A zone on the mech's own level is always used first.

li.label: Chargers on other levels
li.tooltip: With MultiFloors, when a downed or unpowered mech needs charging and no charger is free on its level, haulers carry it up or down the stairs to a free charger on another level. This comes before taking it to a shutdown zone, and also moves mechs already waiting in one.

li.label: Light mechs can use standard chargers *
Craft mech items at the machining table *
li.tooltip: Anything made at the subcore encoder can also be made at a machining table.

li.label: Gestate small mechs in the large gestator *
Craft small upgrades at the advanced assembler *
Extra mech work types *
li.tooltip: Lifters can do Complex Jobs merging and delivering. Constructoids can do Simple Improve work.

li.label: Limit hemogen farming to a pack cap
li.tooltip: Stops queueing extractions from colonists once the map holds this many hemogen packs. When off, farming follows Biotech Patch's own behavior.

li.label: Faster bill tab
li.tooltip: The bill tab redraws each bill's "54/60" count every frame, and mods such as Better Workbench Management make each count slow. This reuses a bill's count for a quarter of a second while it's only being drawn. Colonists deciding whether to work a bill always get a fresh count.

li.label: Build substructure over other substructure
li.tooltip: Gravship substructure can be built over a different kind of substructure, such as Transparent Substructure's over the normal one, or back. It's swapped in place, so the ship stays whole and what stands on it stays put, and the old substructure's materials are dropped.

li.label: Tools category for stockpiles *
li.tooltip: Adds weapons that boost a work stat when equipped to a "tools" category. Weapons with only other stat changes, such as the minigun's move speed penalty, are left out.

li.label: Better tool switching for work
li.tooltip: Takes over Simple Sidearms' "tool use autoswitch" (which must be on). The tool is chosen by the stats each kind of work uses, adding up its bonuses, and a tool with a penalty for the work (such as the bonesaw's surgery success) is never used for it. Cleaning, research and other work without a skill switch too. A tool that slows walking, such as the jackhammer, is put away for the walk to the next job and taken out again when the work starts.

li.label: Colonists fetch tools for their main work
li.tooltip: Colonists pick up a tool from storage for the work they mainly do, best tools to the most skilled, within Simple Sidearms' weight and slot limits (its default limits are too low for heavy tools such as the jackhammer). They carry it back to storage when the work is no longer theirs for a day, or they get a better one. Tools you gave them yourself are never put back. Needs Simple Sidearms' "Tool use autoswitch". With Auto Arm, fetched tools are marked forced so it doesn't swap them for weapons, and outfit policies apply.

li.label: Main work is work priority 1 to {key}
li.tooltip: With manual work priorities. Without them, main work is any enabled work the colonist has a passion for.

li.label: VSE Critical passion, learning rate in other skills *: {key}
li.tooltip: Vanilla Skills Expanded's own value is 0.25.

li.label: Blacksmith gloves global work speed *: {key}
li.tooltip: Medieval Tailor's own value is 0.2.

li.label: Rebalance VFE generators *
li.tooltip: Applies the outputs below and makes the industrial generators minifiable.

li.label: Portable generator output *: {key} W
li.tooltip: VFE's own value is 500 W.

li.label: Industrial generator output *: {key} W
li.tooltip: VFE's own value is 2400 W.

li.label: VFE fabrication bench links to the fabrication cabinet *
Dubs water wells can be placed on gravships *
ReGrowth: no duplicate extinct animals *
li.tooltip: With ReGrowth 2 and ReGrowth: Extinct Animals both active, the dodo, thrinaxodon and synthetion are each added to the same biomes twice, which breaks the wild animal list (Giddy-Up reports it). This removes the second copy. Spawn rates stay the same.
